topic: Emerging Trends in Specialty Chemicals: Process Innovation & Digitalization at Lubrizol
title: Emerging Trends in Specialty Chemicals: Process Innovation & Digitalization at Lubrizol
session_title: Latest Outlook and Key Trends Shaping the Growth of Chemical Industry (Invited Talks)
abstract: The current global landscape presents unique challenges and opportunities for the chemical industry and chemical manufacturers. Lubrizol, a leading global specialty chemicals company headquartered in Ohio, is at the forefront of innovation to advance chemistry in our modern world. This review will cover how Lubrizol is navigating the current environment and discuss how trends such as local-for-local regionalization, sustainability, modular chemical process intensification, adoption of advanced modeling (AI), and others are changing how engineers must work. This talk is intended to be a broad overview of the themes and a call to action on the skills required for chemical engineers in the next decade.
presenting_author: Glenn Cormack | The Lubrizol Corporation, Wickliffe, OH
authors: Glenn Cormack | The Lubrizol Corporation, Wickliffe, OH

topic: Emerging Trends in Decarbonization - the Mission Possible Partnership Story
title: Emerging Trends in Decarbonization - the Mission Possible Partnership Story
session_title: Latest Outlook and Key Trends Shaping the Growth of Chemical Industry (Invited Talks)
abstract: Across industries, there is an emerging “clean industry revolution,” as sector after sector makes its way to a world based on lower carbon. Mission Possible Partnership is tracking over 800 projects around the globe and drawing insights on the barriers faced by the projects. This session will share real world examples from the chemical and related industries, along with tools available to help accelerate the transition. Through the insights and tools shared, attendees will be able to adjust their plans and approaches in meaningful ways.
presenting_author: Gayle Gibson | Mission Possible Partnership, Newark, DE
authors: Gayle Gibson | Mission Possible Partnership, Newark, DE

topic: XL Batteries – Organic Flow Energy Storage
title: XL Batteries – Organic Flow Energy Storage
session_title: Latest Outlook and Key Trends Shaping the Growth of Chemical Industry (Invited Talks)
abstract: Transforming the grid and meeting power demand from expanding industries like cloud services and artificial intelligence requires safe, low-cost and reliable energy storage. XL Batteries uses the power of Organic Chemistry to create a grid-scale battery that will meet rising demand, bolster grid resilience, and enable the transition from fossil fuels to renewable generation. We will be global leaders with a product that can meet any energy storage need. Founded at Columbia University in 2019, XL Batteries has developed a highly-stable, pH-neutral electrolyte that can be used as a replacement for the expensive or corrosive solutions currently used in redox flow batteries. Pairing XL Batteries’ chemistry with an established, mature energy storage technology already at the largest scale opens a rapid, low risk path to commercialization. XL Batteries has advanced from the laboratory to the demonstration scale, with an integrated energy storage system in operation at a customer’s site since early 2025. Deployed broadly, XL’s Organic Flow Batteries will enable the expansion of renewable power generation, reduce dependence on foreign oil and mitigate the effects of burning fossil fuels for energy generation. XL Batteries is leveraging the unique properties of organic chemistry to help address global climate change – the biggest challenge facing our planet.
presenting_author: Paul Evans | XL Batteries, Marlborough, MA
authors: Paul Evans | XL Batteries, Marlborough, MA

topic: Sustainable Innovation at Scale: Meeting Performance and Price Expectations in the Next Generation of Materials
title: Sustainable Innovation at Scale: Meeting Performance and Price Expectations in the Next Generation of Materials
session_title: Latest Outlook and Key Trends Shaping the Growth of Chemical Industry (Invited Talks)
abstract: As global industries face increasing pressure to decarbonize and transition toward more sustainable material solutions, the chemical sector stands at a pivotal point of opportunity and reinvention. This presentation will explore how Modern Meadow’s INNOVERA™ platform—a bio-designed, high-performance alternative —is addressing growing demand for sustainable materials across automotive, fashion, and consumer goods sectors. Focusing on real-world commercial traction and market engagement, this talk will highlight how INNOVERA is aligning with emerging trends in material innovation, supply chain transparency, and performance parity—all while maintaining cost competitiveness. Key insights will include challenges in scaling next-generation materials, the importance of strategic partnerships, and how customer expectations are redefining the role of sustainability in product design. This session aims to provide a practical perspective on how chemical and biomaterials innovation can simultaneously meet climate goals, satisfy rigorous performance standards, and deliver at prices that support widespread market adoption.
presenting_author: David Williamson | Modern Meadow, Nutley, NJ
authors: David Williamson | Modern Meadow, Nutley, NJ
